cdp.slug.restoreHint.en: This title's slug was changed away from the series it is on, {slug}, so every write to crazydramas is held.
cdp.slug.restoreHint.zh: 此剧集的 slug 被改离了它所在的剧集 {slug}，因此所有写入 crazydramas 的操作都已暂停。

seg.meta.cdSlugHint.en: Leave it empty: Studio picks one when the film is imported and checks it on crazydramas. A slug typed here is used as it is.
seg.meta.cdSlugHint.zh: 留空即可：导入影片时 Studio 会自动选择一个并在 crazydramas 上核对。在这里填写的 slug 会按原样使用。
